name: Jiangsu Evergreen New Material Technology Incorporated Company
summary: Jiangsu Evergreen New Material Technology Incorporated Company engages in the research and development, production, and sale of monomers and polymer additives for new polymer materials in China and internationally. It offers triphenyl phosphite, crosslinker, polymer monomer, methyl styrene dimer, ethylbenzene, diethylbenzene, cumene, diisopropylbenzene, methyl styrene dimer, and specialty drier products. The company was founded in 2010 and is based in Zhenjiang, China.
